title: Sunbound, which makes software for handling billing, insurance claims, and payments for senior living operators, raised a $24M Series A led by TTV Capital (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Sunbound, which makes software for handling billing, insurance claims, and payments for senior living operators, raised a $24M Series A led by TTV Capital — Sunbound, which handles billing, insurance claims and payments for senior living operators, has raised $24 million in Series A funding …
